proof_groups.grouping_reason: All three witnesses are obligations for the same straight-line insertion and use one structural proof family: split a circular doubly linked list at the designated anchor, then reassemble the prefix, updated anchor, inserted node, and suffix. Keeping them together lets one worker prove and reuse group-suffixed segment split/concatenation helpers. The group has 3 witnesses, below the controller limit of 12.
proof_groups.proof_strategy: For the entail witness, open xizi_dll and induct over nodes_before to expose the anchor; destruct nodes_after and construct the corresponding spatial orp branch. For each return witness, select the full-list side of the Coq disjunction, rewrite nodes_after with PreH1, use spatial non-aliasing/validity facts to discharge the non-null and non-stop guards required by xizi_dllseg, concatenate the prefix segment with the updated anchor and inserted-node links and the remaining suffix segment, then close xizi_dll with the unchanged sentinel links.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: xizi_dll head (prefix ++ anchor :: suffix), together with anchor <> 0, entails the nil/cons decomposition used by xizi_double_link_insert_after_entail_wit_1: a prefix xizi_dllseg ending at anchor plus anchor links and either sentinel closure (suffix=nil) or the first suffix node, its links, and the remaining suffix segment.

Sentinel links, a prefix xizi_dllseg ending at anchor, updated links anchor->inserted/old_prev and inserted->successor/anchor, and either a nonempty suffix head plus suffix xizi_dllseg or successor=head entail xizi_dll head (prefix ++ anchor :: inserted :: suffix).

premises.premise: the anchor and inserted node satisfy the dllseg non-null and non-stop guards
premises.discharged_by: valid points-to resources and separation from the sentinel fields in the return antecedent; pre_process/entailer can expose the required pure non-aliasing facts
premises.spatial_resource: sentinel, anchor, inserted-node, and suffix-node field stores in the antecedent

premises.premise: suffix is old_next :: rest or nil
premises.discharged_by: PreH1 of return_wit_1 or return_wit_2 respectively

per_witness_plan.proof_of_xizi_double_link_insert_after_e: Open xizi_dll; induct over nodes_before to isolate linklist_pre. Destruct nodes_after. In the nil case instantiate old_prev and first and prove the left spatial-or branch. In the cons case instantiate old_next, rest, first, last, old_prev, and next_next and prove the right branch. Frame the two fresh-node undef stores throughout.
per_witness_plan.proof_of_xizi_double_link_insert_after_r: Choose the first Coq-disjunction branch because its antecedent contains the sentinel links needed to close xizi_dll. Rewrite nodes_after=old_next::rest and unfold xizi_double_link_insert_after_nodes. Splice prefix, anchor->inserted, inserted->old_next, old_next links, and rest segment; then apply xizi_dll_close.

Choose the first Coq-disjunction branch. Rewrite nodes_after=nil and unfold xizi_double_link_insert_after_nodes. Extend the prefix segment with anchor->inserted and inserted->head, use the sentinel links, and apply xizi_dll_close. The resulting last node is inserted.

grouping_reason: A single bounded group is minimal and appropriate because all three same-function witnesses share the xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg split-and-reassembly proof pattern and helper family.
